newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia arrests 14 after guns seized in Sumatra.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia arrests 14 after guns seized in Sumatra.

text.p: Indonesia's armed forces have seized six rifles and detained 14 people suspected of importing the weapons from the Middle East, the official Antara news agency reported on Wednesday.

Major-General Sedaryanto, head of the military region covering the northern half of Sumatra island, told military, political and community leaders in the West Sumatran capital of Padang on Tuesday that the army had seized six assault rifles in West Sumatra last month.
Fourteen people, whom he described as members of a terrorist group, were found in possesion of the weapons and had been handed over to police, he added, according to Antara.
"Those weapons were sent by irresponsible people overseas with the intention of causing a disturbance. However with the help of the community we prevented it," Sedaryanto said.

In the past year, the military has seized 120 guns, mostly Russian-designed AK-47 and American M-16 rifles, along with more than 8,000 rounds of ammunition in the province of Aceh on the northern tip of Sumatra.
The military said in March there was a strong indication that members of the Free Aceh Movement, whose rebellion was crushed in the early 1990s, were planning a comeback.
